records.title: Arbitration & Conciliation Act
details: a to e: The proposed amendments to the Arbitration and conciliation Act, 1966, are under the process of requisite consultations.

records.title: Standardisation Of Hospital Billing Processes
details: (a) & (b): The Bureau of Indian Standards constituted a Working Group of experts to prepare preliminary draft Indian Standard. The industry bodies are also part of the Working Group.
